'''Vineyard''' was a settlement that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==History==
Vineyard was established by [[House Melantha]] in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]], to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] aristocracy on Nyriaan, and thus strengthen the ties between the House and the Galactic Empire. Filled with luxury buildings, it gave Imperials the opportunity to experience the decadence of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] nobility.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the settlement became a target for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] espionage operations on Nyriaan. A number of Alliance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] gained employment at Vineyard as servants and menial laborers, to try and learn secrets from House Melantha's clients.
